newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks open lower but losses limited.
newsitem.headline: French stocks open lower but losses limited.

text.p: French shares started in loss on Friday but showed resilience in regaining some ground.
The market had shed 1.27 percent on Thursday, following weakness in U.S. markets on the back of stronger-than-expected second-quarter growth.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 5.02 points or 0.25 percent at 1,972.54 at 0818 GMT, after opening down 0.44 percent. The CAC-40 futures contract was down at 1,973 from 1,975 at Thursday's close.
Market volume was 1.5 billion francs in mid-morning, boosted by block trades tied to Friday's expiry of futures and options contracts.
